user_story: As a user, I want logging out twice in a row to not cause an error so that the logout action is idempotent.

positive.title: Logout twice successfully
positive.expected_result: User is logged out without any errors and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: Logout after session timeout
steps: Wait for the session to timeout.
positive.expected_result: User is logged out and redirected to the login page without errors.

negative.title: Logout without being logged in
steps: Do not log in to the application.
negative.expected_result: The application provides an error message indicating the user is not logged in.

edge.title: Simultaneous logout requests
edge.expected_result: User is logged out successfully without errors, and the second request does not cause any issues.

edge.title: Logout during a network interruption
steps: Simulate a network interruption during logout.
edge.expected_result: User is logged out without errors despite the network interruption.
